verdict.rationale: A probe shows the Cerebras API reference pages set the Mintlify playground to "simple" display. They offer copyable Python/JavaScript/bash examples, but the in-page runner is disabled and no "Try it" control renders, so the reference itself is not interactive or runnable. The Cloud Console Playground and the downloadable OpenAPI spec are separate features: a prompt-iteration surface and a developer building block. Neither is an interactive API reference, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
